name: vku-room-booking-backend
description: Cloudflare Worker & D1 Database API for VKU Study Room Booking App

scripts.d1:init-local: wrangler d1 execute vku-booking-db --local --file=src/db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute vku-booking-db --local --file=src/db/seed.sql
scripts.d1:init-remote: wrangler d1 execute vku-booking-db --remote --file=src/db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute vku-booking-db --remote --file=src/db/seed.sql
